title: Polynomial continued fractions with factorial reduction: seven hidden low-degree equivalences with proofs, a staged identification pipeline, and eight unidentified candidates
description: Preprint (pcf_paper/paper/pcf_paper_v3.pdf) with code and data. Of fifteen factorial-reduction polynomial continued fractions with irreducible order-4 operators, seven are proven (by coboundaries) to be Mobius transforms of degree-(1,2) PCFs, i.e. ratios of Gauss 2F1 functions; eight remain unidentified and are released as well-tested candidates, not as new constants. All experiments were pre-registered in this repository before they were run.
